title: Add bounded retry helper
prompt: Implement a small, well-tested async retry helper in the target repository. Add a public module-level function retry_async(operation, attempts=3, base_delay=0.01) that awaits a zero-argument callable, retries only on Exception, uses exponential backoff, raises the last exception, and rejects attempts < 1. Add focused tests. Do not change unrelated behavior. Run the relevant tests.
success: The helper exists, validates attempts, retries with exponential backoff, and tests pass.

title: Add CLI JSON output

When supplied, emit one valid JSON object containing at least status, model, and usage fields instead of human-readable completion output; preserve existing behavior without the flag. Add tests for argument parsing and output shape. Run relevant tests.
success: JSON mode works without breaking the default CLI mode and tests pass.

title: Add strict environment parser

Run relevant tests.
success: The parser has clear behavior for valid and invalid input and tests pass.
